zh: 主机恰好有 n/2 台，所以主机内存总和不可能超过“最大的 n/2 个数之和”这个上界。问题是这个上界能不能达到。
把数组排序后分成较小的一半和较大的一半：较小一半中的每个值都不超过较大一半中的任何值，所以任意一一配对都满足“备机 ≤ 主机”，上界可以达到。
把内存值升序排序，累加下标 n/2..n−1 的元素并输出；和可能超过 32 位，用 64 位整数。
en: There are exactly n/2 primaries, so the primaries' total memory can never exceed the sum of the n/2 largest values. The question is whether that bound is reachable.

Sort the array and split it into the smaller half and the larger half: every value in the smaller half is at most every value in the larger half, so any one-to-one pairing satisfies backup <= primary, and the bound is reached.
Sort the memory values ascending and print the sum of the elements at indices n/2..n-1; the sum may exceed 32 bits, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After sorting, choose the n/2 largest servers as primaries and the rest as backups.

## Proof of correctness

Any choice has only n/2 primaries, and their sum cannot exceed the sum of the larger half. Every value in the smaller half is <= every value in the larger half, so any one-to-one matching satisfies backup <= primary, reaching the upper bound.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
